title: SOFR Rate Snapshot - April 10, 2026
summary: SOFR closed at 3.57 on April 9, 2026, down 2 basis points from the prior day's reading of 3.59. The rate has declined steadily over the observation period, falling 9 basis points from the April 2 close of 3.66.
key_points: Total decline over the period: 9 basis points from April 2 to April 9

market_structure_context: SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate) is calculated by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York from tri-party repo market transactions. The declining trend from 3.66 to 3.57 suggests a modest easing in short-term dollar funding costs over the observation period. SOFR serves as the replacement for LIBOR in most new contracts and is critical to the operational framework of US money markets.
